title: sessions.saved
description: The hub's (plan 046 B2): the saved sessions — the sessions of the hub's own session index that no running host serves, chosen as the session list chooses its saved rows — each with the id that reopens it. Of a provider craze can resume only; one per craze id (its newest row, carrying its newest title), a row with none by its own provider session id; less every session a live host in the registry serves (by craze id, and by provider and provider session id whether or not the row has a craze id), a host marked stopping excepted, so a stopping session is listed saved at once. Then, in this order: the workspace filter (an exact match on the row's directory), the sub-agent filter (excluded unless subAgents), newest first by updatedAt (ties by id), and the limit. No workspace is stat'ed. An index row over a row bound (each in bytes), whose directory is not absolute, or whose time cannot be written in UTC, is skipped as malformed. A read: neither session-scoped nor mutating; every call reads the index and the registry again. Bad params are bad_request (an unknown member, reason unknown_field); an index that cannot be read answers no sessions (the hub logs why); a registry that cannot be read, or a live host's entry in it, is unavailable, reason host_unreachable. A member given twice is bad_request. A host answers unsupported, reason hub_only; a hub that cannot answer it refuses it unsupported, reason unsupported (or unknown_method, a hub from before it).

workspace.description: Only the sessions whose directory is exactly this one: an absolute path, which the hub cleans first. Absent for every directory.

limit.description: The most sessions to list; absent for 50. Written as an integer: the hub refuses a fraction or an exponent (50.0, 1e2), which JSON Schema's integer admits.

subAgents.description: List the sessions a sub-agent ran too, each marked subAgent; absent for false, which leaves them out.

sessions.description: The saved sessions, newest first by updatedAt, ties by id: at most the limit, and at most 1 MiB in all (protocol.SavedResultBytesMax), the hub dropping trailing sessions to keep within it. [] for none, and when the index cannot be read.

more.description: There were other saved sessions the params' filters kept that the limit, or the 1 MiB bound, left out.

savedSession.description: One saved session, from its index row.

id.description: What reopens it, opaque to a client: its craze session id, or <provider>:<providerSessionId> for an index row with none (an older craze's) — the form craze serve --load takes. At most 512 bytes: the hub skips a longer row; maxLength, which counts characters (JSON Schema cannot count bytes), is a weaker bound than the hub's.

crazeSessionId.description: Its craze session id; absent for an index row with none. At most 512 bytes (its id's bound); maxLength counts characters, a weaker bound.

provider.description: Its provider id (cursor, grok, native): one this craze can resume.

providerSessionId.description: The provider's id for its last agent session. At most 512 bytes: the hub skips a longer row; maxLength counts characters, a weaker bound.

workspace.description: The directory it ran in, absolute, as its index row holds it; not checked to exist still. At most 4096 bytes: the hub skips a longer row; maxLength counts characters, a weaker bound.

title.description: Its craze id's newest title (the index row's own, for a row with none), cut to 120 characters; absent for none.

createdAt.description: When its index row was created, in UTC; the zero time (0001-01-01T00:00:00Z) for a row that records none. A row whose time cannot be written in UTC with a four-digit year is skipped as malformed.

updatedAt.description: When it was last active, as its index row says, in UTC.

subAgent.description: A sub-agent ran it: listed only when the params' subAgents asked for them. Absent otherwise.
